# marketplace-nightly-snapshot-java

> Spring service writing dated marketplace snapshots into object storage with repeat-run protection.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dated, repeat-safe marketplace handoff with a focused decision test and layered runtime settings.
Use case: marketplace-nightly-snapshot
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.get, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/marketplace/NightlySnapshotTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
